content:
Updates the hostnames, hostname wildcards, IP addresses, and IP address ranges that Tenable
Vulnerability Management matches against targets in auto-routed scans. For more information
about supported route formats, see Supported Scan Routing Target Formats.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role and Can Edit [64] scan permissions. See Roles and
Permissions.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
integer <int32>
The ID of the scanner group. Corresponds to the id  element in the 200
response for the GET /scanner-groups endpoint.
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
application/json
Array of strings
A list of zero or more hostnames, hostname wildcards, IP addresses, CIDR
addresses, or IP ranges. For more information about supported route
formats, see Supported Scan Routing Target Formats.
